title: Algebraic spaces over S are equivalent to pairs over S' mapping to S
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism S -> S' of a big fppf site, the category of algebraic spaces over S is equivalent to the category of pairs (F', F' -> S) consisting of an algebraic space F' over S' together with a morphism F' -> S over S' (source lines 3065-3087). The proof assigns j_!F to F, uses the induced equivalence of categories of sheaves to reduce to the statement that a sheaf F is an algebraic space whenever j_!F is one, and then reads a presentation U'/R' of j_!F back as an etale equivalence relation over S to get F = U/R.
